contributionMap.claim: Theorem A: real homogeneous polynomial V of degree k >= 3 is meromorphically (equivalently rationally) integrable for H = sqrt(1+|p|^2) + V iff, after a rotation, V = c q1^k or (k even) V = c (q1^2+q2^2)^(k/2)
